label_source: human gold (IndEgo) + human OOD labels; synthesis of E3.01-E3.04
protocol: tolerance selection on label-oracle clip error (isolates sampling from model error); model error stated separately because full-coverage OOF estimate already errs 0.167/4-7 verdicts
decisions: ADOPT IndEgo-like (480p/10fps assembly-logistics): probe every 2nd window (51% windows, clip-fraction err 0.049 [0.019,0.087], 7/7 verdicts, delay 0.3 windows) + early exit after 4 s observed (AUROC 0.860 vs 0.848 full). Combined ~0.20 footage processed (~0.9 h per 4.4 h, x5).
BUDGET OPTION: every 3rd window (35%, err 0.117, 6/7 verdicts, delay 1.3 windows) only if half-cost is refused; every-4/6/8 miss bad stretches (miss_L up to 3/7).

DROP CUSUM-as-sampler: default (d=0.1,h=0.5) never fires on flat OOF streams (identical to every-4 grid); LOCO-tuned (mostly h=0.3) matches grid error (LOCO errM 0.214 vs every-4 0.209) at equal cost. Keep CUSUM only for physical-collapse early-reject (lab scope).
DROP skip-first-M for IndEgo: err 0.088->0.418, verdicts fall to 5/7; start is the cleaner part.

OOD Egocentric-10K factory: NO skip rule (MW p=0.42 raw/0.47 normalised, n_bad=9) and NO certified sparse policy — transfer fails (frozen models 0.4-0.53) so sampling policy is moot until the scorer works. Re-run position test at n_bad~24 (labels2).
Sampling is NOT the bottleneck: model clip-fraction err 0.167 at FULL coverage, 4/7 verdicts. Fix the scorer (E5) before squeezing sampling further.
thin_evidence: 7 clips only: CIs span ~0.07-0.18 on errL; pallet2 n=6
OOD position test n_bad=9: null result is absence of evidence, not evidence of absence
gold windows are a sparse sample of each clip: 'full coverage' = all gold windows, not exhaustive video; true continuous-clip errors need dense labels
early-exit curve is IndEgo-only; OOD curve needs a working OOD scorer
adopted_indego: probe every 2nd window + 4 s early exit; budget option every 3rd; CUSUM-as-sampler dropped; no skip rule
